rules.question: What happens in the interface when someone mentions a person who is not a member of the channel?
rules.rule: When a user mentions someone who is not a member of the channel, the web interface prompts them to add that person to the channel.

rules.question: What notification appears when a work package is switched from manual to automatic scheduling?
rules.rule: Switching a work package from manual to automatic scheduling displays a warning banner stating that its dates are not determined by child work packages.

rules.question: How do the displayed IDs compare when work packages are created consecutively in different projects?
rules.rule: By default, newly created work packages display numerical IDs from a single instance-wide sequence, regardless of project.

rules.question: What happens to multiline text when the user selects the 1 Board option?
rules.rule: When the user selects the 1 Board option for multiline text, the whole text is kept as one board title.

rules.question: What duration does a meeting agenda section display when its items have different durations or no duration specified?
rules.rule: Each meeting agenda section must display the sum of the specified durations of its contained items.

rules.question: What happens when a document's processed text contains only whitespace?
rules.rule: Documents whose processed text is empty or contains only whitespace are skipped.

rules.question: How does changing the project’s attachment visibility setting affect a work package’s Files tab?
rules.rule: The project’s attachment visibility setting determines whether the attachments option appears in the Files tab of its work package detailed views.

rules.question: What activity history appears on a board after using each board duplication option?
rules.rule: Duplicating a board with either duplication option excludes the source board's existing board and card activity events from the duplicate's activity history.

rules.question: What happens when a user enters a title and description and starts a thread?
rules.rule: The web interface must allow a user to start a discussion thread with a title and description.

rules.question: What appears in the selected user's account list after account delegation is confirmed?
rules.rule: Confirming Delegate access makes the shared mail account appear in the selected delegate's account list marked as delegated.

rules.question: How does a playbook task display text containing Markdown syntax?
rules.rule: Playbook task text containing Markdown is displayed with Markdown formatting.

rules.question: What happens when a user uploads an MP2T video with the .m2t extension?
rules.rule: The web upload interface accepts MP2T video files with the .m2t extension.

rules.question: What happens to week-number visibility when you change “Show week of year (ISO 8601)” before clicking Save?
rules.rule: Toggling “Show week of year (ISO 8601)” in the board Date popup immediately updates the week-number display without requiring Save.

rules.question: What information about voters is visible to participants viewing an anonymous poll?
rules.rule: When a chat poll is anonymous, participants cannot see who voted for each option.

rules.question: How is a standard Duplicate link labeled when viewed from each end?
rules.rule: Standard Duplicate links display as duplicates or is-duplicated-by according to their direction.

rules.question: What appears in the Starred overview after a reader stars a public board they do not belong to and reloads?
rules.rule: After a logged-in reader stars a public board they do not belong to and reloads, that board appears in their Starred overview.

rules.question: What happens to the displayed results when the work package table configuration changes?
rules.rule: Changing the work package table configuration automatically updates the results displayed in the table.

rules.question: How does a message display attachments that the current user cannot access because of their attributes?
rules.rule: Attachments restricted by attribute-based permissions must appear in messages with the placeholder "Files not available" and subtitle "Access to files is restricted based on attributes".

rules.question: What does a guest experience when opening a magic login link?
rules.rule: Guests using a magic login link can log in through the web interface without entering a password.

rules.question: What options appear when you open the project's More menu?
rules.rule: The project's More (three dots) dropdown menu must include an "Add a subproject" option.

rules.question: Which placement option is initially selected when the Add Swimlane popup opens?
rules.rule: When the Add Swimlane popup opens, Below selected swimlane is selected by default.

rules.question: Which timezone option is selected before the user changes their preferences?
rules.rule: The timezone preference defaults to Automatic.

rules.question: How does an exported work package document display page breaks in its description?
rules.rule: When a work package description contains page breaks, the exported document splits its contents into separate pages at those breaks.

rules.question: How does archiving a project affect what appears in the project selector?
rules.rule: An archived project must not appear as a selectable option in the project selector.

rules.question: How does a channel message appear when its original language differs from your preferred language?
rules.rule: Channel messages are automatically translated into the user's preferred language.

rules.question: What activity history appears in a board after it is duplicated?
rules.rule: Duplicating a board does not copy the source board's existing board or card activity events into the duplicate.

rules.question: What happens to the minicard and full-card field order when a field is moved in Show on Minicard?
rules.rule: Reordering a field in either display-order list changes its position on the corresponding card surface without changing its position on the other surface.

rules.question: What options are available for determining a new member's permissions during invitation?
rules.rule: When inviting a new member, the web interface must allow selecting an existing user role, group, or placeholder user's permissions as the basis for the new user's permissions.

rules.question: What label identifies the folder feature toggle under Account Settings > Features?
rules.rule: The folder feature toggle under Account Settings > Features is labeled "Folders".

rules.question: How does enabling Sort favorites up affect the message list?
rules.rule: When Sort favorites up is enabled in Mail appearance settings, favorite messages appear in a separate section above the rest of the message list.

rules.question: Which destinations are highlighted when you drag an archived multi-selection?
rules.rule: When dragging an archived multi-selection, the destinations highlighted in green must be exactly Remaining and all existing Workspaces.

rules.question: Where does a previewed attachment appear in the PDF?
rules.rule: In a PDF viewed from the web interface, an attachment with a displayed preview does not appear in the attachment bullet list.

rules.question: What happens when a user tries to invite a guest without selecting any channels?
rules.rule: When inviting a guest, the user must select at least one channel before the invitation can be submitted.

rules.question: What options are available for inviting participants in the Meeting section of conversation settings?
rules.rule: The conversation settings Meeting section must offer a CSV upload option for bulk inviting email participants.

rules.question: How does the import screen handle Jira status names such as constructor or proto?
rules.rule: Jira import must preserve status names as literal text, including names such as constructor or proto.

rules.question: What happens when a non-superuser tries to grant superuser status to another user?
rules.rule: A user may grant superuser status to another user only if the acting user is a superuser.

rules.question: How can users enter dates in the start and finish date fields?
rules.rule: Users can set work package start and finish dates by typing into the corresponding date fields.

rules.question: What does the Project wiki settings page show when project wikis are disabled globally?
rules.rule: When project wikis are disabled globally, the Project wiki settings page remains visible and displays a notice that wikis must first be enabled globally in administration settings.

rules.question: Which template options appear in project settings for a non-administrator?
rules.rule: Only administrators can see the options to set a project as a template or remove it from templates.

rules.question: What happens to an existing custom field value when that field is added to the document without specifying a value?
rules.rule: Adding a custom field to a document without specifying a value must preserve any existing value of that field on the document.

rules.question: What happens to a persistent notification after the recipient reacts to an urgent message containing an @mention?
rules.rule: A persistent notification for an urgent message containing an @mention stops repeating when its recipient acknowledges, reacts to, or replies to the message.

rules.question: What does the shopping list display after adding these two cheese quantities with Food enabled?
rules.rule: With Food enabled, shopping-list entries for 1 cup of cheese and 2 cups of cheese must combine into one entry showing 3 cups of cheese.

rules.question: What happens when a user tries to start a thread from a message in a new deployment?
rules.rule: In a new Mattermost deployment, users can create threads by default.

rules.question: How does owner selection work when creating an external library?
rules.rule: When creating an external library, the web interface must allow assigning it to exactly one user.

rules.question: What appears in the conversation list after creating a Calendar event with a Talk location when no conversation exists yet?
rules.rule: Creating a Calendar event with a Talk conversation as its location creates a conversation visible in the conversation list if none exists yet.

rules.question: What happens to a folder after you delete it?
rules.rule: Deleting a folder under normal conditions moves it to the trash bin instead of permanently deleting it.

rules.question: How does the message conversation type affect the availability of Quarantine for Review?
rules.rule: The Quarantine for Review action is available only for messages in public or private channels, not in direct or group messages.

rules.question: How does the placement and method of inserting a work package link affect its appearance in a document?
rules.rule: A linked work package is displayed as a full-width card only when linked using a slash command on an empty line.

rules.question: How can a user manage reminders for events across a calendar?
rules.rule: Users can configure a default reminder for all events in a calendar through that calendar's settings.

rules.question: Which actions appear in the leave confirmation for an already-muted public channel joined through a membership policy?
rules.rule: When leaving an already-muted public channel joined through a membership policy, the confirmation dialog shows Cancel and Leave channel instead of Mute instead.

rules.question: Which results appear when you search for Printing in Full path or folder mode?
rules.rule: In Full path or folder search mode, a query matching part of an asset's original path must include that asset in the results.

rules.question: What happens when a user without Organize group data permission attempts to add a new food?
rules.rule: A user must have Organize group data permission to create a new food through the web interface.

rules.question: How does team creation handle the team URL when anonymous team and channel URLs are enabled?
rules.rule: When anonymous team and channel URLs are enabled, the web team creation flow assigns the team URL automatically without prompting the user to choose it.

rules.question: What happens to a card’s title or description during synchronization when its upstream text changes, with and without local edits?
rules.rule: Synchronizing an upstream title or description change updates the corresponding card text only if it still matches the last synchronized source value, preserving locally edited text otherwise.

rules.question: How does adding a board member behave for users with different organization and team memberships when membership restrictions are enabled?
rules.rule: When either membership restriction is enabled, a non-admin inviter can add a user to a board only if that user shares an organization or team of an enabled kind with the inviter or an active board member.

rules.question: What happens when a user with channel permission to create checklists, but no playbook access, tries to create a checklist in the channel?
rules.rule: A user with channel permission to create checklists can create a checklist in that channel without separate playbook access permissions.

rules.question: How does the web interface respond to changes in the operating system’s contrast setting while automatic theme mode is selected?
rules.rule: When automatic theme mode is selected, OpenProject must match the operating system’s contrast setting.

rules.question: What happens when you drop multiple selected boards onto Home?
rules.rule: Dropping multiple selected boards onto Home must display "Please select only one board" while leaving Home and the selection unchanged.

rules.question: What happens when a user submits a status update without selecting a reminder?
rules.rule: Users can submit a status update without setting a reminder for the next status update.

rules.question: What warning, if any, does the date picker show about manual scheduling?
rules.rule: The OpenProject date picker must display a yellow banner warning that manual scheduling will ignore existing relations.

rules.question: What happens when a user without User management permissions tries to edit their own profile through My Profile?
rules.rule: A user without User management permissions can edit their own profile through My Profile.

rules.question: What happens to participants when breakout rooms are created during a call?
rules.rule: Using breakout rooms in a web call divides the call into smaller groups.

rules.question: Which sprint fields can a user edit when shared sprint fields are read-only?
rules.rule: When shared sprint fields are read-only due to permissions, the project-specific sprint goal remains independently editable.

rules.question: What category-related fields appear when a channel admin creates a channel?
rules.rule: When the feature is enabled, channel admins creating a channel see a field labeled “Default category (optional)”.

rules.question: What mode is the recurring meeting template in immediately after creating a meeting series?
rules.rule: After a user creates a meeting series, the recurring meeting template opens in draft mode by default.

rules.question: What happens to the minicard's section order when a user reorders the sections of an opened card?
rules.rule: Changing the section display order for an opened card must not change the minicard's section display order.

rules.question: When can a user view a device password in the web interface?
rules.rule: A device password is accessible in the web interface only when it is created.

rules.question: How does applying a Food Label rule affect which recipes appear in the pool?
rules.rule: A recipe-pool rule using a Food Label includes only recipes with an ingredient bearing that label.

rules.question: What happens when a user attempts to use {{doc_title}} in a title assignment?
rules.rule: The {{doc_title}} placeholder cannot be used in title assignment.

judge_controls.answer: When you close a task, any subtasks that were still open or in progress are set to done.
judge_controls.rule: Closing a task marks all of its unfinished subtasks as done.

judge_controls.answer: Duplicate foods are merged into one line and their quantities added, so 1 and 2 cups become 3 cups.
judge_controls.rule: A shopping list combines items with the same food: 1 cup plus 2 cups of cheese shows 3 cups.

judge_controls.answer: Closing a task hides it from the board; its subtasks keep whatever status they had.
judge_controls.rule: Closing a task marks all of its unfinished subtasks as done.

judge_controls.answer: I am not sure how templates work in this application.
judge_controls.rule: Only administrators can set a project as a template.
